name: Bodysuit
definition: Close-fitting one-piece top of jersey or stretch fabric that covers the torso and fastens under the crotch, worn as a top (baby bodysuits included); a body sold as lingerie is underwear.
notes: Desigual sells women's bodysuits as their own category (lace-trimmed strappy bodysuits); also Next, Kith, THE ICONIC categories (search only). Crotch fastening separates it from the T-shirt; lingerie bodies stay A1.5.1.01.

name: Bondage trousers
definition: Close-cut punk trousers with straps joining the legs, zips and D-rings, often with a detachable bum flap; tartan or black cotton is an attribute.
notes: Seditionaries bondage trousers sold on the King's Road in 1977 (receipt with the auction lot); museum pair thought to come from BOY, London; Tripp NYC and ACDC Rag make them today (search).

name: Thobe (thawb)
definition: Loose ankle-length robe with long sleeves, pulled over the head and worn as the main garment, mostly by men in Arab, North African and Sudanese dress; collar and cuffs are attributes (kandura, dishdasha, jalabiya, djellaba and gandoura are named forms).
notes: Riwaya (UK marketplace) has a Thobe category: Plain Classic Saudi Thobe, Omani Mint Dishdasha; ankle length, long sleeves. Jumia Egypt has a 59-product Men Galabeya category. A women's embroidered Palestinian thob is a dress.

name: Boubou
definition: Very wide flowing robe cut from a broad length of cloth with a neck opening and sides left open or sewn low, worn over a tunic and trousers in men's sets or alone as a gown in West African dress; agbada is a named form.
notes: TAE Couture (Cotonou) makes Boubou Brodé; Mumini Fashion Empire (Freetown) sells men's agbadas. No dress, cape or poncho kind covers the open-sided robe.

name: Tunic suit (shalwar kameez)
definition: Set of a long tunic reaching the hip or below worn over matching trousers or a skirt and sold together (shalwar kameez, kurta pyjama, ao dai, baju kurung, puletasi); the tunic alone is the kurta.
notes: Khaadi sells men's salwar kameez (PK); Manyavar White Kurta Pajama category, 60 sets (IN); ao dai two-piece sets on Weee (US); baju kurung sets in Malaysia. The HVMK kurta-set named form moves here (two regions now shown, C11).

name: Hanbok
definition: Korean traditional outfit of a short jacket (jeogori) tied with a ribbon worn over a full high-waisted wrap skirt (chima) or wide trousers (baji); the long coat (durumagi) is worn over it.
notes: The Korean In Me sells modern hanbok: Chueok Long Jeogori, Gureum Wrap Chima. Ruqun is defined as Chinese dress; no generic kind covers the jeogori set.

name: Wrap robe (deel, chapan)
definition: Long-sleeved robe whose fronts overlap and are held by a sash, belt or side fastenings, worn as the main garment or as a coat (Mongolian deel, Bhutanese gho, Central Asian chapan); kimono and yukata keep their kinds.
notes: MD Mongolia sells a deel category (Pearl Deel, Cotton deel); Mursak sells Chapans for men and women; gho sold in Thimphu shops. The kimono kind is defined as Japanese; no coat kind covers a sash-closed robe.

name: Track jacket
definition: Zip-front jacket of tricot or other smooth synthetic knit with a stand collar and ribbed or elastic cuffs and hem, worn alone or as the top of a tracksuit; tracksuit trousers are joggers.
notes: Jumia Egypt lists 41 men's track jackets (Sportswear Unisex Black Track Jacket, Argentina track top); Jules B titles a Men's Track Jackets category. Not a hoodie, fleece or shell jacket by fabric and cut.

name: Abaya
definition: Loose long-sleeved over-garment reaching the knee or ankle, worn by women over other clothes for modest dress in public, open-front or closed; the Iranian manteau is a named form.
notes: Devr-i Tesettür New Season Abayas, 129 products, open-front and closed (TR). Not a dress (worn over clothes) or a tailored overcoat.

name: Sherwani
definition: Fitted knee-length coat with a standing collar, buttoned down the front and worn over close trousers such as churidar for weddings and formal South Asian dress; achkan is a named form.
notes: Pernia's Pop-Up Shop Designer Sherwani category, 6,959 products; long coat-like garment past the knees worn with churidar (Seema Gujral, Vanshik sets).

name: Headscarf (hijab)
definition: Scarf or sewn covering worn over the head to cover the hair and often the neck, wrapped and pinned or pulled on (instant hijab, underscarf, tudung); a scarf worn round the neck is the scarf.
notes: Singapore shops sell instant and semi-instant hijabs and underscarves (TudungPeople, Sufyaa, Modanisa); Hijab Vault (Skokie, US) sells hijabs and under-caps. Head-zone use and sewn forms differ from the neck scarf (A1.7.01).
